title: Temperature scaling and expected calibration error
hints: nll(logits, y, T) is the mean cross-entropy of softmax(logits / T): use the provided log_softmax on logits / T and pick out the label column with np.arange(N), y.

The NLL is a smooth function of a single scalar, so any bracketing search works. Search over log T between log(lo) and log(hi): evaluate a coarse grid, then refine around the best point with golden-section or ternary search until the bracket is narrower than tol.

ECE: confidence = probs.max(1), correct = probs.argmax(1) == y. Bin the confidences into n_bins equal-width bins on (0, 1]; for each non-empty bin add (count / N) * |mean(correct) - mean(confidence)|.
